import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    a = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    mx = max(a)
    mn = min(a)
    k = (mx - mn) // 2
    print(mx - k)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
